name: next-on-pages-next-14
description: Runs Next.js 14 on Cloudflare Pages via @cloudflare/next-on-pages

scripts.preview: yarn pages:build && wrangler pages dev .vercel/output/static --config wrangler.toml --compatibility-date=2025-06-07 --compatibility-flag=nodejs_compat --functions .vercel/output/functions
scripts.deploy: yarn pages:build && wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static --config wrangler.toml --project-name next-on-pages-next-14 --compatibility-date=2025-06-07 --compatibility-flag=nodejs_compat --functions .vercel/output/functions
